user_story.capability: to set color, brightness, and effect with speed from the web UI
user_story.benefit: I retain every lighting control the previous UI offered

criteria.trigger: the owner selects a color via the color picker or a preset swatch
criteria.behavior: send the chosen red, green, and blue values to the Server and display the selected color

criteria.trigger: the owner changes the brightness control
criteria.behavior: send the corresponding brightness value in the range 0 to 255 and display the level as a percentage from 0 to 100

criteria.trigger: the owner selects an effect
criteria.behavior: send the selected effect name together with the speed value when the effect uses speed, and display the current effect

criteria.trigger: the selected effect is the solid effect
criteria.behavior: hide the speed control

criteria.trigger: the owner moves the brightness or speed control continuously
criteria.behavior: coalesce updates so that no more than one value is sent per 80 milliseconds of control inactivity
populate the selectable effect list from the effect set the Server advertises rather than a hard-coded list

user_story.capability: a live preview of the LED panel
user_story.benefit: I can see the current output without looking at the physical light

criteria.trigger: the dashboard is shown
criteria.behavior: open a WebSocket to the Server and render each received frame as the panel's 32 LED colors in an 8-by-4 grid
render the preview grid in the same orientation as the physical panel, reversed along both the horizontal and vertical axes

criteria.trigger: the preview WebSocket connection closes
criteria.behavior: attempt to reopen it within approximately 1 second

user_story.capability: to see whether the device is reachable
user_story.benefit: I can trust what the UI shows

criteria.trigger: the Server responds successfully to health checks
criteria.behavior: display an active status indicator

criteria.trigger: a health check fails
criteria.behavior: display an offline status indicator
refresh the displayed light state at least once every 5 seconds so the controls stay consistent with the device

user_story.capability: to name my device and light
user_story.benefit: it is identifiable across the UI and integrations

criteria.trigger: the owner opens the identity settings
criteria.behavior: display the current device name, room, and light label

criteria.trigger: the owner saves identity settings with a non-empty device name and light label
criteria.behavior: send the values to the Server and display the saved result

criteria.trigger: the owner attempts to save identity settings with an empty device name or empty light label
criteria.behavior: reject the request with a client error and THE Web UI SHALL surface the error

user_story.capability: to configure Wi-Fi and pick from nearby networks
user_story.benefit: I can move the device onto my network from the UI

criteria.trigger: the owner opens the Wi-Fi settings
criteria.behavior: display the current SSID, security type, autoconnect preference, whether a password is already set, and the connected network when known

criteria.trigger: the owner requests a scan
criteria.behavior: request nearby networks from the Server and present them as selectable SSID choices

criteria.trigger: the owner saves Wi-Fi settings
criteria.behavior: send the SSID, password, security type, and autoconnect preference to the Server and display the resulting status

criteria.trigger: a Wi-Fi scan cannot be performed
criteria.behavior: return an error and THE Web UI SHALL surface it without discarding the entered SSID

user_story.capability: to configure an MQTT broker connection
user_story.benefit: the light integrates with my home automation

criteria.trigger: the owner opens the MQTT settings
criteria.behavior: display the enabled state, broker URL, client id, username, subscribe topic, publish topic, and whether a password is already stored, without revealing the stored password

criteria.trigger: the owner saves MQTT settings without entering a new password
criteria.behavior: preserve the previously stored password

criteria.trigger: the owner saves MQTT settings with the clear-password option selected
criteria.behavior: remove any stored password

criteria.trigger: the owner saves MQTT settings that are invalid
criteria.behavior: reject them with a client error and THE Web UI SHALL surface the reason

criteria.trigger: the owner opens the MQTT settings
criteria.behavior: display the availability topic, whether Home Assistant discovery is enabled, and the Home Assistant discovery prefix

criteria.trigger: the owner saves MQTT settings
criteria.behavior: send the availability topic, the discovery enabled state, and the discovery prefix together with the other MQTT fields

user_story.capability: to enable HomeKit and see a pairing code
user_story.benefit: I can add the light to the Home app

criteria.trigger: the owner opens the HomeKit settings
criteria.behavior: display the accessory name, the enabled state, and the current pairing status

criteria.trigger: HomeKit is enabled and ready to pair but not yet paired
criteria.behavior: display the pairing code

criteria.trigger: the owner saves HomeKit settings with a non-empty accessory name
criteria.behavior: send the values to the Server and display the updated status

criteria.trigger: the owner attempts to save HomeKit settings with an empty accessory name
criteria.behavior: reject the request with a client error and THE Web UI SHALL surface the error

user_story.benefit: I can control remote access to the device

criteria.trigger: the owner opens the SSH settings
criteria.behavior: display the currently authorized keys

criteria.trigger: the owner requests validation of entered keys
criteria.behavior: report whether the keys are valid

criteria.trigger: the owner saves valid authorized keys
criteria.behavior: send them to the Server and reflect the saved result

criteria.trigger: the owner saves keys that fail validation
criteria.behavior: reject them with a client error and THE Web UI SHALL surface the error

user_story.capability: to restart the service, reboot, or power off the device
user_story.benefit: I can manage it without a shell

criteria.trigger: the owner confirms a restart-service, reboot, or poweroff action in the system-power dialog
criteria.behavior: request that action from the Server and confirm that it was queued

criteria.trigger: a system action other than restart-service, reboot, or poweroff is requested
criteria.behavior: reject it with a client error

criteria.trigger: the owner cancels the system-power dialog or presses Escape
criteria.behavior: close the dialog without requesting any action

user_story.capability: to move between the dashboard and settings sections with shareable URLs
user_story.benefit: navigation feels like a normal web app

criteria.behavior: provide client-side navigation among the dashboard and the identity, Wi-Fi, MQTT, HomeKit, SSH, and device settings sections, each reachable at a distinct URL path

criteria.trigger: a browser requests any of the Web UI's client route paths directly
criteria.behavior: respond with the SPA entry document so the requested view renders

criteria.trigger: the owner uses browser back or forward navigation
criteria.behavior: display the view corresponding to the resulting URL

user_story.capability: the UI to load in a single round-trip

criteria.trigger: the Web UI requests the bootstrap resource
criteria.behavior: return, in one response, the current light state, the available effect set, and the identity, Wi-Fi, MQTT, HomeKit, and SSH settings

criteria.actor: field values in the bootstrap response
criteria.behavior: equal the values the corresponding individual endpoints return for the same state
complete its initial data load using the bootstrap resource without issuing separate per-section requests for that initial render

user_story.capability: the site to load reliably regardless of which URL I open

criteria.trigger: a browser requests a bundled asset path
criteria.behavior: respond with that asset's content and a matching content type

criteria.trigger: a browser requests a path that is not an API route, not the WebSocket route, and not a bundled asset
criteria.behavior: respond with the SPA entry document
continue to route API and WebSocket requests to their handlers rather than serving the SPA entry document in their place

criteria.trigger: a browser requests a bundled asset path that does not exist
criteria.behavior: respond with a not-found status rather than the SPA entry document

user_story.capability: the device build to need only a Rust toolchain
user_story.benefit: the Pi never needs a Node toolchain

criteria.trigger: the project is built with only a Rust toolchain present and no Node or npm available
criteria.behavior: succeed and produce a binary that serves the complete web UI
serve the entire web UI from the single binary without reading web assets from disk at runtime

criteria.trigger: the committed Bundle does not match what the frontend source would currently produce
criteria.behavior: report the discrepancy

user_story.benefit: the rewrite does not widen its exposure

criteria.behavior: issue every API and WebSocket request to the same origin from which it was served

criteria.trigger: an API or WebSocket request presents a non-LAN Host header or a foreign Origin header
criteria.behavior: reject it with a forbidden response

user_story.capability: the new UI to stay small
user_story.benefit: it remains suitable for an embedded device

criteria.actor: compressed JavaScript and CSS of the Bundle together
criteria.behavior: be no larger than 50 kilobytes

user_story.benefit: I know whether a change took effect

criteria.trigger: a settings save or system action succeeds
criteria.behavior: show a transient confirmation message

criteria.trigger: an API request fails
criteria.behavior: show a transient message describing the failure

user_story.capability: the light to report whether it is online
user_story.benefit: Home Assistant shows the entity's true availability

criteria.trigger: the Server establishes its MQTT broker connection
criteria.behavior: register a Last-Will message that publishes an offline payload to the configured availability topic if the connection is lost

criteria.trigger: the Server is connected to the broker with MQTT enabled
criteria.behavior: publish an online payload to the configured availability topic
publish availability messages with the retain flag set so a subscriber receives the current availability immediately on connecting

criteria.trigger: MQTT is disabled or the Server shuts down cleanly
criteria.behavior: publish an offline availability payload before disconnecting

user_story.capability: the light to register itself in Home Assistant automatically
user_story.benefit: I do not configure the entity by hand

criteria.trigger: MQTT and Home Assistant discovery are both enabled
criteria.behavior: publish a retained discovery configuration for the light under the configured discovery prefix so that Home Assistant creates the light entity automatically
include a stable unique identifier, a device block, and references to the light's command, state, and availability topics
describe the light's controllable attributes of on/off, color, and brightness consistent with the device's capabilities

criteria.trigger: MQTT or Home Assistant discovery is disabled
criteria.behavior: clear the previously published discovery configuration so that Home Assistant no longer offers a stale entity
